entries.title: Dictate reading comments and Field Notes
entries.description: While online, hold the microphone inside the text box and release it to add your speech as text in English, Afrikaans or both. Review and correct the text before saving; your corrections help future notes recognise names and local words.

entries.title: Keep recording as your finger moves
entries.description: The page stays still while you hold the microphone, and slight finger movements no longer end your recording. Saving is paused until transcription finishes.
